alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:9ed34cdb-7.title: Workplace Coordinator
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:9ed34cdb-7.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE: Baseten is looking for a Workplace Coordinator to help run our San Francisco office and create an exceptional experience for everyone who works in or visits the space. You will work alongside our Office Manager and be at the center of the day-to-day operations of our largest and fastest-growing office. Over 200 employees are based in San Francisco today, and we expect that population to more than double over the next year. We are also expanding from one space into two additional nearby buildings, creating a campus-like footprint that regularly hosts visiting employees, candidates, customers, investors, and events. A major focus of this role is making our increasingly complex space work well. You will manage high demand for conference rooms and phone booths, anticipate competing needs, and make thoughtful tradeoffs based on team and business priorities. Like a great EA managing an executive’s calendar, you will constantly look ahead, spot conflicts, and adjust the puzzle. You’ll be part of a growing, highly collaborative team that works together to raise the bar for how we support Baseten. The team shares context, jumps in to support one another, and continuously looks for ways to improve how we operate. As Baseten grows, you’ll have opportunities to take on new challenges and expand your scope. This is an in-person role in San Francisco, expected to be in-office five days per week. RESPONSIBILITIES: - Own front-of-house reception, creating a warm, polished experience for employees, candidates, customers, investors, and other visitors - Own conference room and space management across our growing SF footprint, proactively resolving conflicts and optimizing space based on business priorities - Plan ahead for high-priority and large-group needs, including onboarding, sales bootcamps, candidate interviews, customer visits, confidential meetings, marketing events, and board meetings - Build enough context on our teams and business to make good judgment calls when space is constrained - Maintain an exceptionally high bar for the physical office, noticing and addressing details like rooms that need resetting, missing furniture, broken equipment, and low supplies - Proactively identify ways to make our spaces more functional, organized, and enjoyable - Build strong relationships across the office to understand and anticipate team needs - Partner with the Office Manager with physical office operations, vendors, deliveries, supplies, and other workplace needs - Support in-office events, including setup, logistics, and resetting spaces afterward - Respond quickly to workplace needs and own issues through resolution REQUIREMENTS: - Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a high quality bar and an instinct for noticing what others miss. Proactive and observant, with a bias toward identifying and solving problems before being asked. - Highly organized and able to manage changing calendars, constraints, requests, and priorities without dropping details - Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand context and make thoughtful tradeoffs - Clear, responsive communicator who reliably keeps people informed and closes loops - High ownership mentality. arootah-arootah:lever:b754b2ba-52fd-4791.description: About the Role Our client, a leading quantitative investment firm, is seeking a Systematic Fixed Income Portfolio Analyst to support its fixed income and macro investment initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and technology professionals in a highly analytical, fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, technically skilled, and passionate about applying data-driven analysis to financial markets. This individual will contribute to portfolio analytics, investment research, risk evaluation, and the ongoing enhancement of systematic investment processes.
responsibilities: Support portfolio managers and investment teams through quantitative analysis, portfolio monitoring, and market research.
Develop and maintain analytical tools used for portfolio evaluation and risk assessment.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable investment insights.
Assist in the implementation and refinement of systematic investment approaches across fixed income markets.
Collaborate with technology and research teams to improve workflow automation and reporting capabilities.
Evaluate portfolio exposures and assist with performance attribution and risk analysis.
Produce reporting materials and investment analytics for internal stakeholders.
Contribute to ongoing research projects related to financial markets, portfolio construction, and investment strategy development.
qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Physics, or another quantitative discipline.
1–4 years of experience in portfolio analytics, quantitative research, investment management, risk analysis, or financial technology.
Familiarity with fixed income products, macroeconomic analysis, or systematic investment strategies is a plus.
Exposure to machine learning, cloud technologies, or data engineering tools is beneficial.

At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide. As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:69.description: Position Summary The Sales Manager (SM) is responsible for driving business development, cultivating strong customer relationships, and managing a multi-million-dollar book of business. This role combines technical expertise with consultative selling to deliver tailored process solutions for customers across multiple industries. The SM identifies and secures new business opportunities, manage a sales pipeline from prospecting through close, maximizes penetration of existing accounts, and provides expert-level product and application knowledge. Reporting to the CEO, the SM collaborates with internal teams and Production Manager to ensure profitability, customer satisfaction, and long-term growth. This role is well suited to a self-directed, results-driven sales professional with a strong background in manufacturing sales who thrives on generating new business.
responsibilities: Business Development & Sales Growth
Prospect, research, and identify new customer opportunities; plan and execute strategies to integrate leads into the business development plan.
Conduct market research to understand industry trends, competitor activity, and client needs and market conditions.
Maximize penetration of existing accounts by introducing additional products and solutions, including upgrading projects.
Develop and execute a business plan and professional portfolio to track and measure progress toward revenue goals. Prepare accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reports for company leadership.

Customer Relationship Management

Provide timely responses to customer inquiries, support requests, and service needs.
Negotiate sales, pricing, and terms to reflect customer value while ensuring profitability.
Follow up regularly with clients to ensure satisfaction and repeat business.
Reporting & Administrative Duties
Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports, including pipeline forecasts and goal updates.
Maintain and update CRM to track customer activity, sales opportunities, and performance metrics.
Submit weekly expense reports, travel plans, and business updates in a timely manner.
Manage travel expenses responsibly, including vendor travel, hotels, and client-related costs.
Communicate effectively with internal teams to align customer requirements with company resources and SOPs.
qualifications: Proven experience in industrial, Distributor and manufacturing sales, process consulting, or technical account management. Electronics Manufacturing sales experience preferred, but not required.
Strong knowledge of industrial process equipment and ability to develop technical expertise.
Demonstrated success in business development, customer relationship management, and revenue growth.
Proficiency in CRM systems, forecasting, and expense management.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced growth oriented environment.
Strong organizational and time management abilities.
Strong prospecting and business development skills, with the ability to independently build a pipeline from the ground up. Existing Book of Business is preferred, but not required.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:083b494f-52de-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You’ll own strategies across SEO, AEO, GEO, paid advertising, email marketing, landing pages, and e-commerce optimisation. Your focus will be on generating qualified B2B leads, increasing online sales, and strengthening customer acquisition and retention. You’ll work across diverse customer segments and extensive product catalogues, connecting marketing activity directly to commercial outcomes. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution, experimentation, analytics, and continuous optimisation. It’s an ideal opportunity for an analytical, results-driven professional who wants their work measured by revenue, conversions, and sustainable business growth. Develop and execute an inbound marketing strategy focused on generating qualified B2B enquiries, quote requests, bulk orders, reseller opportunities, account applications, and online sales. Build targeted campaigns and lead-generation funnels for different industries, customer segments, product categories, and purchasing needs. Partner with sales and management teams to track leads from initial enquiry through conversion, improve lead quality, and introduce lead scoring, automated follow-up, and nurturing workflows. Optimise product, category, service, and location-based pages to improve rankings and visibility across traditional search engines and AI-generated search results. Develop commercially focused content around pricing, bulk purchasing, product comparisons, specifications, delivery information, and frequently asked questions. Create and optimise high-converting landing pages for retail, wholesale, reseller, corporate, and government audiences. Improve calls to action, forms, account applications, checkout journeys, and other conversion points through testing and behavioural analysis. Manage and optimise the e-commerce platform, including product information, descriptions, specifications, imagery, category structures, pricing, stock information, promotions, and customer journeys. Develop strategies to increase average order value, purchase frequency, and repeat revenue through bundles, volume offers, cross-selling, upselling, promotions, and abandoned-cart recovery. Plan, launch, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, remarketing, display, and relevant Meta or LinkedIn channels. Manage advertising budgets and continuously improve cost per qualified lead, customer acquisition cost, and return on advertising spend. Build segmented email marketing and automated lifecycle campaigns covering new enquiries, quote follow-ups, abandoned carts, account applications, repeat-order reminders, customer reactivation, product launches, and promotions. Analyse campaign, CRM, website, and sales data to identify which marketing activities generate customers and revenue rather than relying on vanity metrics. Build and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards covering leads, quote requests, e-commerce sales, conversion rates, organic performance, advertising efficiency, average order value, repeat purchasing, and marketing-attributed revenue. Identify priority products, customer segments, and growth opportunities in collaboration with sales and management teams. Continuously test, measure, and refine marketing initiatives to improve commercial performance and establish clear attribution between digital activity and revenue.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:89b9278c-8996-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Netherlands. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs.
